This is a targeted, source-verification update for named candidates, not a systematic search or screen; no inclusion/exclusion screening was applied beyond verifying each named source.

Sources reached without a recorded query are marked as such in lit_sources.json (DOI lookup of brief-supplied DOIs; local PDFs supplied in the brief; reference tracing from Greinert et al. 2023 ref. [19] for CFQT v1.0).

Roberts & Bybee 2014 and Borup et al. 2006: only Crossref metadata confirmed; content unverifiable here and not to be cited for specific claims.
